messages.content:
Risk: Confidential Data (ID: atlas-confidential-data-in-prompt)
Description: Confidential information might be included as a part of the prompt that is sent to the model.
Concern: If not properly developed to secure confidential data, the model might reveal confidential information or IP in the generated output. Additionally, end users' confidential information might be unintentionally collected and stored.
Policy: Clinical Staff Credentials & Institutional Data

Axis: Exposure of Sensitive Information Due to Incompatible Policies (http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#CWE-213)
Roles: object
Siblings:
  - http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#CWE-359: Exposure of Private Personal Information to an Unauthorized Actor
  - http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#CWE-1273: Device Unlock Credential Sharing
  - http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#CWE-1258: Exposure of Sensitive System Information Due to Uncleared Debug Information
  - http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#CWE-538: Insertion of Sensitive Information into Externally-Accessible File or Directory
  - http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#CWE-203: Observable Discrepancy
  - http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#CWE-497: Exposure of Sensitive System Information to an Unauthorized Control Sphere
  - http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#CWE-1431: Driving Intermediate Cryptographic State/Results to Hardware Module Outputs
  - http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#CWE-209: Generation of Error Message Containing Sensitive Information
  - http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#CWE-201: Insertion of Sensitive Information Into Sent Data
  - http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#CWE-1295: Debug Messages Revealing Unnecessary Information

Axis: LLM Data Leakage (http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#AML.T0057)
Roles: agent
Siblings:
  - http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#AML.T0077: LLM Response Rendering - ATLAS
  - http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#AML.T0024: Exfiltration via AI Inference API - ATLAS
  - http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#AML.T0086: Exfiltration via AI Agent Tool Invocation - ATLAS
  - http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#AML.T0056: Extract LLM System Prompt - ATLAS
  - http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#AML.T0025: Exfiltration via Cyber Means - ATLAS
